d.s: Sika Confibre 19F is a fibrillated polypropylene fibre for use in concrete.
a: Increased resistance to plastic shrinkage cracking
us: Sika Confibre 19F Is used in concrete to increase the strain capacity of the fresh concrete, thereby, reducing the incidence of plastic shrinkage cracking. Is typically used in concrete for the following applications:
Can be used in both dry and wet shotcrete applications for:

sec.t: Complies with ASTM C1116/ C1116M, Type III fiber reinforced concrete and therefore ASTM D7508. Complies with European Standard EN 14889-2:2006 Fibres for Concrete Class 1b .
The unopened boxes can be stored for indefinite period in a dry environment, protected from direct sunlight.
Place the bag directly into the ready mixed truck or central mixer. Mix for a minimum of three (3) minutes or until fibres are evenly distributed through concrete.

The recommended minimum dose rate of Sika Confibre 19F is 0.9kg (1 bag) per cubic metre of concrete. Optimum dosage depends on the type of concrete, site conditions, mix proportions and desired plastic and hardened concrete properties. Laboratory and/or field trials are essential in determining the optimum dosage.

cp.heading: USES

cp.text: Sika® Confibre® 19F is not a structural fibre and therefore should not be used as a substitute for structural steel or steel fibres in structural applications.
